name: Rogue Bot Hunter
tagline: Keeps watch over the fleet of bots you already run
description: Follows four lines of enquiry across the bots you already operate: what they cost to run, whether anyone has cloned them, where they overlap each other, and which corner of the market they hold. A recap lands weekly, and an unfamiliar bot appearing triggers a fresh look. It watches and reports, nothing more.
author: LeTerryBZH
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
